definitions.asset-ready: Every original SVG in the family is exported locally with a typed registry and source integrity checks. This status applies to static icon masters, not interactive component variant completion.
definitions.partial: A reusable implementation exists. Remaining source variants, production state/theme comparisons, or integration checks are still required; a full source fixture matrix alone does not mark a family complete.
definitions.pending: Family metadata is archived; React implementation and high-fidelity visual inspection are outstanding.
definitions.excluded: Excluded by the user, or a file organization/thumbnail page.
